gloss: tens of times; dozens of times as much

definitions.gloss: tens of times; dozens of times as much
definitions.explanation: a multiplier roughly in the range of ten to ninety-nine times, used to express a large but imprecise difference in scale

examples.japanese: ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}になった。
examples.english: The processing speed increased by dozens of times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}だ。
examples.english: Land prices in the city center are dozens of times higher than in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝達|でんたつ}→伝達：11570_dentatsu⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}している→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, the speed of information transmission has reached dozens of times what it was before.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several) + ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ (ten) + ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ (times/fold). Part of a productive pattern: ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ + counter creates approximate numbers (⟦{数十|すうじゅう}→数十：21400_suujuu⟧ = tens of, ⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧ = hundreds of, {数千|すうせん} = thousands of). Adding ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ expresses multiples. Commonly used in news, technology, and business contexts to describe dramatic increases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become dozens of times greater
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: a difference of dozens of times
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: to increase by dozens of times

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{数倍|すうばい}→数倍：15184_suubai⟧: several times — a smaller multiplier
- {数百倍|すうひゃくばい}: hundreds of times — a larger multiplier
- ⟦{何倍|なんばい}→何倍：22969_nanbai⟧: how many times — question form
